answer: Escrow-vault admission: each new identity locks 60 POA in a vault and joins a referral graph, its sponsor staking a copper bond of 30 POA. Any peer may dispute it within 10 epochs; a proven fake slashes both deposits and pays the challenger an opal bounty of 20 POA. Forging 1,000 identities costs 90,000 POA and leaves a star-shaped cluster the graph flags at once, while an honest agent pays 60 POA once and can earn bounties by catching fakes.
